description: Expected-residue baseline for scripts/vm-install-residue-harness.ps1. Every entry is derived from docs/installer-residue-and-hkcu-intent.md (the authoritative intent note) and from packaging/file_assoc_uninstall.nsh, which that note names as the authority for the registry half. scripts/check-installer-residue-baseline.ps1 re-derives all of it and fails on any difference, so this file cannot silently drift from the documented intent.
hkcu_intent_note: The uninstaller deliberately does NOT delete HKCU\Software\PDFE. Surviving HKCU user data is INTENDED and must never be reported as residue by the harness.

expected_surviving.filesystem_note: Empty by derivation: the intent note records that PDFE persists user data through QSettings in its default NativeFormat backend, i.e. in the registry under HKCU\Software\PDFE\PDFE. No installer-created filesystem artifact is expected to survive uninstall.

user_data_sentinels.note: Written by the harness before uninstall / before the upgrade install; every path here MUST lie inside the preserved HKCU scope or the per-user app-data scope, and the harness asserts each one still exists afterwards (WIN-04 / WIN-93).

installer_sources.artifact: Installed files under `$INSTDIR\bin` (exe, DLLs, tessdata, model, Qt runtime)
installer_sources.removed_by: CPack/NSIS auto-generated uninstaller (`Delete`/`RMDir` from the install manifest)

installer_sources.artifact: File-association / ProgID / capabilities registry keys (HKCR + HKLM)
